verdict.rationale: Ramp states that when a card is swiped it captures the receipt and fills in memos and categories, codes the spend to the correct GL account, and auto-approves it when within policy. It also chases missing receipts and memos (reminders, CLI missing/memo-suggestions) and syncs accounting fields to QuickBooks in real time, with a built-in reconciliation tool. That covers point-of-spend coding feeding a review-style close. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-coding accuracy, and in-depth first-party docs on how coding rules and categorization work (the evidence is mostly marketing-page claims).
